Subject: Synapse-Redwood connector: proposed validation kickoff and spec pack

Hi Jonas,

Following our intro last week, attaching the Synapse connector spec and a short proposal for a technical validation window. We think a focused 2-week validation (staging only) will capture the perf/compat gaps your engineers care about. High-level asks from our side:

- Test against sequences up to 4k tokens and mixed-batch loads (1–64)
- Validate KV cache reuse across conversation shards
- Confirm behavior with quantized 4-bit variants (if Redwood exposes q4/8 paths)
- Smoke test streaming+function-calls with a sample toolchain (we've linked a demo repo)

Attachments: synapse-connector-specs-v1.pdf (protocol, auth headers, sample manifest), demo-repo link inside.

Proposed kickoff: Mon 2026-12-07. Can you confirm engineers and a point-of-contact for infra? Also looping in Martin from our consultancy partner who will help with the QA plan.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Head of Integrations, Synapse AI
A: +1 (415) 555-0199

Camila (integration lead) and Marcus (runtime perf) are tagged — Camila will coordinate test scenarios, Marcus will own perf scripts. Lauren (partnerships) will shepherd contract/comms.

2) demo repo: can you point to a branch that uses streaming+function-calls? We prefer a reproducible harness.
3) test data: please confirm sample payloads (PII-free) and whether you need redwood-provided eval prompts.

—Jonas

Subject: Re: Synapse-Redwood connector: proposed validation kickoff and spec pack

Thanks Aisha — read the spec this morning. A few technical questions to scope perf tests and the validation matrix:

- Can Synapse expose a non-prod endpoint under the same auth schema (so we can run 2 weeks of sustained traffic)? If not, we need a mock that presents identical headers and response shapes.
- For quantized variants: what model sizes & flavoring do you expect clients to use? (gpt-ish 7B/13B/70B analogs?)
- Streaming topology: will the connector send chunked events or expect SSE? There are implications for our streaming adapter.
- KV cache semantics: does the connector expect token-level continuity across restarts or only session-scoped caches?

Deliverables from Redwood for the window:
- redwood-synapse-qa-test-plan.xlsx (draft attached) — includes test cases, owners, pass criteria
- rdw-mvp-reference-arch.drawio — reference architecture for the PoC network layout

I recommend we add a short pre-kickoff call (30m) on Thu 2026-12-05 to align infra & cert exchange.

Camila Reyes
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-synapse-qa-test-plan.xlsx
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@synapse.ai>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Martin Cole <martin.cole@mmc-llc.com>, procurement@synapse.ai
Date: 2026-12-04T08:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Synapse-Redwood connector: proposed validation kickoff and spec pack

Camila — great questions, answers below inline: 

- Non-prod endpoint: yes, we can provision a staging endpoint mirroring prod behavior for up to 30 days. Will provide an ingress host and TLS certs.
- Model sizes: supporting Synapse-Base-13B and Synapse-XL-70B; quantized builds available for the 13B family (q4x). We'll include a manifest mapping in the staging bundle.
- Streaming: we support chunked server-side streaming (HTTP/2) with a JSON framing layer — our demo branch uses streaming+function-calls. Link: https://github.com/synapse-ai/redwood-connector/tree/staging-streams
- KV semantics: session-scoped by default; optional persistent KV for long-running sessions (requires the persistent-kv flag).

I'll attach the staging manifest and a short runbook for cert exchange. The staging host is provisioned once we sign the MSA addendum; procurement looped for the contract.

Quick note on data: we'll only accept PII-free payloads in staging; please use our sample payloads or masked replacements.

We can do Thu 2026-12-05 09:30 PT for a 30m pre-kickoff — that works for my team.

Best,
Aisha

Attachments: synapse-staging-manifest.json (link inside email), staging-cert-runbook.pdf
